issues.display_title: Issue #1242: Integrate Sub Menu View Filter With Check Box
issues.main_description_html:
• Show Stared : When this is active, only see Stared Images
  • Show Folders : When this is not active, do not display folders
  • Show Non Images : When this is not active, hide the pts files

🐛 Bug — "View" sub-menu filter checkboxes do not filter the grid

Status: 🟠 Open bug — logged for sanity re-test in the latest version Tester: ekosy9 · Date: 2026-06-08 · Suite: qa_testing/e2e/view_navbar/sub_menu.spec.ts (Playwright + Electron, native menu driven via the Main Process) Test directory: C:\Users\Work\Test GoThru Photo Studio\binary\View (34 items total)

Expected (acceptance criteria)

  • Show Starred active → display only starred images.
  • Show Folders inactive → hide folders.
  • Show Non Images inactive → hide .pts files.

Actual (observed)

Toggling the View sub-menu checkboxes does not re-filter the grid as specified:

ScenarioFilters checkedItems shownResult
S1Show Starred only34 (all)❌ should show only the starred subset
S1Folders only34 (all)❌ no change
S1Non Images only6⚠️ count changes (semantics unverified)
S2Starred + Folders34❌ no filtering
S3All three34—
S4None checked34 (all)❌ grid not hidden / not emptied

Core defect: the Show Starred and Show Folders filters have no effect on the displayed grid — the count stays at the full 34 regardless of their state. Unchecking all filters also still shows all 34 items (Scenario 4 fails its hidden/empty-state check). Only Non Images visibly changes the count.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Load the workspace directory …\binary\View (34 items).
  2. Open the top navbar View menu.
  3. Check Show Starred only (uncheck Folders + Non Images).
  4. Observe: the grid still shows all 34 items instead of only starred images.

Automated result

3 passed / 1 failed (Scenario 4 — empty/hidden state). Run video + per-scenario full-screen screenshots attached below.

🎬 Run recording (app window — 4 scenarios)

🖼️ S1 — Show Starred only → still 34 items (no filtering)

🖼️ S2 — Starred + Folders → 34

🖼️ S3 — All three → 34

🖼️ S4 — None checked → still 34 (FAILED: grid not emptied)
